SELECT SN.ID, SN.REC_VER, SN.CONTENT, SDV.VALUE_NAME AS TYPE_NAME FROM sys_notice sn LEFT JOIN sys_dict_value sdv on sdv.DICT_KEY = 'SYS_NOTICE_TYPE' AND SDV.VALUE = SN.TYPE
WHERE 1 = 1 AND SN.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND SN.TYPE = 'ANNOUNCEMENT' AND SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM IS NULL AND SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO IS NULL
union all
SELECT SN.ID, SN.REC_VER, SN.CONTENT, SDV.VALUE_NAME AS TYPE_NAME FROM sys_notice SN LEFT JOIN sys_dict_value sdv on sdv.DICT_KEY = 'SYS_NOTICE_TYPE' AND SDV.VALUE = SN.TYPE WHERE 1 = 1 AND SN.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND SN.TYPE = 'ANNOUNCEMENT' AND SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM IS NOT NULL AND SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO IS NOT NULL and NOW() BETWEEN SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM AND SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO
UNION ALL
SELECT SN.ID, SN.REC_VER, SN.CONTENT, SDV.VALUE_NAME AS TYPE_NAME FROM sys_notice SN LEFT JOIN sys_dict_value sdv on sdv.DICT_KEY = 'SYS_NOTICE_TYPE' AND SDV.VALUE = SN.TYPE WHERE 1 = 1 AND SN.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND SN.TYPE = 'ANNOUNCEMENT' and SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM IS NOT NULL AND SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO IS NULL AND NOW() >= SN.EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM
